subject: Payment path eligibility & trial -> billing start plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finops.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap — procurement path options & trial success gates

Alex — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on procurement readiness and when billing would begin: 

Recap from the call:
- FinOps Labs wants to validate Redwood for event-driven cost optimization use cases (LLM-driven summarization + embeddings).
- Trial target: ~50k tokens/day across 2 service endpoints; p95 latency target <300ms for generation flows.
- Primary ask: procurement needs clarity on payment path (PO vs. card) and any marketplace route.
- Security checks: network scanning window and SOC2 evidence requested by procurement.

Proposed commercial routes (pick one):
1) Purchase Order (PO) — you submit a PO, we invoice monthly. Typical lead time: 7–14 business days for procurement review.
2) Card on file — fastest (trial -> billing same day after usage threshold).
3) AWS Marketplace — interested if you need consolidated billing / reseller benefits; will require marketplace listing onboarding (2–4 weeks).

Trial-to-billing options:
- Option A (threshold-triggered billing): Billing begins once trial crosses 50k tokens/day for 3 consecutive days OR after integration sign-off (SSO + sample production request).
- Option B (date-triggered billing): Set a firm billing start date (e.g., 2026-10-01) regardless of usage.

Next steps I suggest:
- Alex: confirm preferred payment path (PO / card / marketplace) and procurement contact for paperwork.
- Monica: I’ve attached a Mutual Action Plan template and Redwood PO instructions — can you prep a checklist for procurement asks (network scan window, SSO SAML metadata, SOC2 package)?
- Neha: please flag any commercial constraints (discounting, minimum term) we should surface to Alex.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, redwood_po_instructions.pdf

Thanks — I’ll hold off on SOW drafting until payment path is confirmed.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finops.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@financecorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — procurement path options & trial success gates

Thanks Ben — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement preference: PO preferred. Our legal/procurement team will push for a standard PO process. They will need a short SOW and a network scan window.
2) Marketplace: Nice to have, but not required for initial deployment — we can evaluate marketplace for future scale.
3) Success criteria for trial (internal):
   - Sustained throughput: >=50k tokens/day for at least 3 days
   - Latency: p95 < 300ms for generation path
   - Integration: SSO working + demo of end-to-end flow in staging

Billing start: we prefer threshold-triggered billing tied to the success criteria. If thresholds are not met, we can revisit and extend the trial. If procurement needs a date, target no earlier than 2026-10-01.

Procurement contact: Priya Shah (cc’d) will be primary. Procurement email: procurement@finops.io

I’ll work with Priya to share SOC2 artifacts and schedule a network scan window for next week.

Thanks,
Alex
Director, Platform Engineering | FinOps Labs
alex.turner@finops.io

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finops.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@financecorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — procurement path options & trial success gates

Got it — PO + threshold-triggered billing is fine. I’ve attached a short SOW draft (sow-draft-finops-20260914.docx) and the MAP template so procurement can see dates and responsibilities. 

Monica/Neha — can you: 
- Monica: confirm typical turnaround for a PO with our billing team and capture any required distribution list for invoices.
- Neha: flag T&Cs that might conflict with PO billing (e.g., minimum term, termination notice) and propose language for a short SOW.

Alex/Priya — action items for your side:
- Priya: please confirm procurement contact list and preferred PO referencing (PO number format).
- Can we schedule a short legal/procurement review call Thursday 09/15 10:00–10:30 PT? If that works for your team I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: sow-draft-finops-20260914.docx, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

—
Ben

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-13T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — procurement path options & trial success gates

Quick procurement checklist for PO path (from Redwood billing & legal):
- Standard PO processing: 5–10 business days after receipt of signed SOW and PO number.
- Required items from buyer: PO number, billing contact email, billing address, tax ID (if applicable).
- Security evidence: we will provide SOC2 Type II package and a network scan window (we prefer 48–72h notice).
- Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears, NET30 default (exceptions require finance approval).
- Marketplace: if they choose AWS Marketplace later, billing would be consolidated there; onboarding takes 2–3 weeks and needs a marketplace contract.

Internal next steps: 
- Ben: share SOW draft with Alex/Priya and send invite for procurement review on 2026-09-15 10:00 PT.
- Neha: review SOW for standard termination and liability caps; propose minimal edits.
- I’ll draft the PO intake checklist and attach to the MAP.

—
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Alex/Priya — thanks for confirming PO + threshold-triggered billing. Final logistics: 

1) I’ve scheduled the procurement review: 2026-09-15 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
2) SOW draft attached for quicker PO processing. Please sign or comment via DocuSign link (https://www.docusign.com/sow/abc123) so we can generate an invoice once PO is received.
3) Billing start logic we’ll use: billing will begin automatically when the trial meets the 50k tokens/day threshold for 3 consecutive days AND integration sign-off (SSO + sample request). If that happens before 2026-10-01 we’ll start billing on the threshold date; otherwise billing will start on 2026-10-01.
4) Next internal owners: Monica to own procurement checklist & network scan window; Neha to finalize SOW terms; I’ll own PO intake and HubSpot deal stage update.

Relevant links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890) and MAP in Drive (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-mupaplan).

If everything looks good, Priya — please confirm your PO numbering format and an email for invoicing. Once we have the PO number we’ll mark the trial "billing-ready" in our system.

Thanks all — looking forward to the procurement call tomorrow.

—
